description: This file declares functions related to managing speed boost data, providing interfaces to set and get speed boost parameters via blob data and parameter values.

methods.name: setBlobDataOfSpeedBoost
methods.description: Sets blob data related to speed boost parameters.

methods.name: getBlobDataOfSpeedBoost
methods.description: Retrieves blob data related to speed boost parameters.

methods.name: getParamIntValOfSpeedBoost
methods.description: Gets integer value of a speed boost parameter.

methods.name: getParamStringValOfSpeedBoost
methods.description: Gets string value of a speed boost parameter.
